output.summary: A flowering plant of unspecified native origin. It usually blooms from August to October with yellow or white flowers and yellow pollen. Its flower heads, flowers, young leaves and petals are eaten after preparations including pickling, brewing, cooking or blanching.
output.edibilityNote: Flower heads are pickled in vinegar; flowers make tea, young leaves are steeped or cooked, and petals are blanched for dishes.
